cards.imageAlt: 模拟机训练航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the simulator training scene shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的模拟机训练场景中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: I can see two pilots seated in a full-flight simulator. The cockpit has realistic flight instruments, controls, and outside visual displays. They appear to be practising normal or abnormal procedures in a controlled training environment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我看到两名飞行员坐在全动飞行模拟机内。驾驶舱配有逼真的飞行仪表、操纵装置和外部视景显示。他们似乎正在受控的训练环境中练习正常或非正常程序。

cards.audioText: What are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟机训练有哪些好处？
cards.referenceText: Simulator training can improve situational awareness. It gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and gives them more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 模拟机训练可以提高情景意识。它能为飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。
